[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Salt Flats]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Salt Flats in the [[Crystal Desert]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear the Salt Flats in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.

: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''
